Crash · Finland

Ukrainian drones crash in southeast Finland on 29 March

29 March 2026 · Kouvola area

Confirmed Ukrainian-origin incursions; investigation concluded

Two drones crashed in southeast Finland on 29 March 2026, north of Kouvola and in Luumäki. The September investigation findings establish Ukrainian origin and attribute the diversion to GNSS jamming and weather, not an intended attack on Finland.

The investigation concluded without further criminal liability; the entries nevertheless remained unlawful. The original grouped occurrence and published URL are retained.
